## Data Inputs

```{r paths}
repo_root <- normalizePath("..")
box_2025 <- file.path(repo_root, "2025", "master_boxscore.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(box_2025))
```

## Feature Build (Boxscore Priors)

```{r feature_build}
load_box_totals <- function(path, season) {
  raw <- suppressMessages(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))
  df <- raw %>%
    filter(player == "School Totals", str_to_lower(table_type) == "basic") %>%
    transmute(
      season = season,
      game_id,
      game_date = as.Date(game_date),
      sid = str_trim(team),
      opp_sid = if_else(is.na(opponent) | opponent == "", "no_sid", str_trim(opponent)),
      across(
        .cols = setdiff(names(.), c("game_id","game_date","team","opponent","table_type","player")),
        .fns = ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)),
        .names = "tm_{.col}"
      )
    )
  df
}

prior_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  s <- cumsum(replace(x, is.na(x), 0))
  n <- cumsum(!is.na(x))
  lag(s) / lag(n)
}

build_model_df <- function(box_path, season_label) {
  box_totals <- load_box_totals(box_path, season_label) %>%
    mutate(
      sid = as.character(sid),
      opp_sid = as.character(opp_sid)
    ) %>%
    filter(opp_sid != "no_sid") %>%
    filter(stringr::str_ends(game_id, "_w")) %>%
    distinct(game_id, sid, .keep_all = TRUE)

  opp_stats <- box_totals %>%
    select(game_id, sid, starts_with("tm_")) %>%
    rename(opp_sid = sid) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^tm_", "opp_"), starts_with("tm_")) %>%
    distinct(game_id, opp_sid, .keep_all = TRUE)

  box_full <- box_totals %>%
    left_join(opp_stats, by = c("game_id", "opp_sid")) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "%", "pct")) %>%
    mutate(
      across(starts_with("tm_"), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))),
      across(c(starts_with("opp_"), -all_of("opp_sid")), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))),
      win = as.integer(.data[["tm_PTS"]] > .data[["opp_PTS"]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(win))

  tm_cols  <- names(box_full)[startsWith(names(box_full), "tm_")]
  opp_cols <- names(box_full)[startsWith(names(box_full), "opp_")]

  box_prior <- box_full %>%
    dplyr::arrange(game_date) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sid) %>%
    mutate(
      gp_prior = lag(cumsum(rep(1L, dplyr::n()))),
      across(all_of(tm_cols),  prior_mean, .names = "pr_{.col}"),
      across(all_of(opp_cols), prior_mean, .names = "pr_{.col}")
    ) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  opp_prior <- box_prior %>%
    select(sid, game_id, gp_prior, starts_with("pr_")) %>%
    rename(opp_gp_prior = gp_prior) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("opp_", .x), starts_with("pr_"))

  model_df <- box_prior %>%
    left_join(opp_prior, by = c("opp_sid" = "sid", "game_id" = "game_id")) %>%
    filter(gp_prior >= 1, opp_gp_prior >= 1) %>%
    distinct(game_id, sid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(game_date, sid, opp_sid) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(stringr::str_ends(game_id, "_w")), game_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  model_df
}

model_df <- build_model_df(box_2025, "2025")
cat("Model rows available:", nrow(model_df), "\n")
```

## Shared Helpers

```{r helpers}
auc_manual <- function(labels, scores) {
  labels <- as.integer(labels)
  n_pos <- sum(labels == 1L)
  n_neg <- sum(labels == 0L)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(scores, ties.method = "average")
  sum_pos_ranks <- sum(r[labels == 1L])
  auc <- (sum_pos_ranks - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
  as.numeric(auc)
}

clamp01 <- function(p, eps = 1e-6) {
  pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
}

log_loss <- function(y, p) {
  p <- clamp01(p)
  -mean(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p))
}

brier <- function(y, p) {
  mean((p - y) ^ 2)
}

ece_score <- function(y, p, n_bins = 10) {
  cuts <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  bins <- cut(p, breaks = cuts, include.lowest = TRUE)
  bin_df <- tibble(y = y, p = p, bin = bins) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      p_hat = mean(p),
      y_hat = mean(y),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  sum((bin_df$n / sum(bin_df$n)) * abs(bin_df$p_hat - bin_df$y_hat))
}

make_feature_mats <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  drop_cols <- c("season","game_id","game_date","sid","opp_sid","win","gp_prior","opp_gp_prior")
  num_cols_train <- names(train_df)[vapply(train_df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  feature_cols <- setdiff(num_cols_train, drop_cols)
  feature_cols <- feature_cols[grepl("^pr_|^opp_pr_", feature_cols)]
  if (length(feature_cols) == 0) return(NULL)

  train_features <- as.data.frame(train_df[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE])
  test_features  <- as.data.frame(test_df[, intersect(names(test_df), feature_cols), drop = FALSE])

  colmap <- stats::setNames(make.names(names(train_features)), names(train_features))
  names(train_features) <- unname(colmap[names(train_features)])
  names(test_features)  <- unname(colmap[names(test_features)])
  missing_in_test <- setdiff(names(train_features), names(test_features))
  if (length(missing_in_test) > 0) for (mc in missing_in_test) test_features[[mc]] <- NA_real_
  test_features <- test_features[, names(train_features), drop = FALSE]

  train_means <- vapply(train_features, function(x) mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  train_means[is.na(train_means)] <- 0
  for (nm in names(train_features)) {
    v <- as.numeric(train_features[[nm]]); v[is.na(v)] <- train_means[[nm]]; train_features[[nm]] <- v
  }
  for (nm in names(test_features)) {
    v <- as.numeric(test_features[[nm]]); v[is.na(v)] <- train_means[[nm]]; test_features[[nm]] <- v
  }

  list(train = train_features, test = test_features)
}

eval_dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-12-15"), as.Date("2026-01-05"), by = "day")
```

## Rolling Predictions (Out-of-Sample)

```{r rolling_preds}
roll_preds_xgb <- function(df) {
  all_preds <- list()
  for (d in eval_dates) {
    train_df_day <- df %>% filter(game_date < d)
    test_df_day  <- df %>% filter(game_date == d)
    if (nrow(test_df_day) == 0 || nrow(train_df_day) == 0) next

    mats <- make_feature_mats(train_df_day, test_df_day)
    if (is.null(mats)) next

    x_train <- data.matrix(mats$train)
    x_test  <- data.matrix(mats$test)
    y_train <- train_df_day$win
    y_test  <- test_df_day$win

    params <- list(
      objective = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric = c("logloss", "auc"),
      max_depth = 5,
      eta = 0.05,
      min_child_weight = 5,
      subsample = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 0.8
    )
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train, missing = NA)
    dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test,  label = y_test,  missing = NA)
    set.seed(42)
    model <- xgb.train(
      params = params,
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = 300,
      evals = list(train = dtrain),
      early_stopping_rounds = 15,
      verbose = 0
    )

    pred <- predict(model, dtest)
    all_preds[[as.character(d)]] <- test_df_day %>%
      transmute(
        date = game_date,
        game_id, sid, opp_sid,
        win = y_test,
        pred = as.numeric(pred)
      )
  }
  bind_rows(all_preds)
}

roll_preds_logreg <- function(df) {
  all_preds <- list()
  for (d in eval_dates) {
    train_df_day <- df %>% filter(game_date < d)
    test_df_day  <- df %>% filter(game_date == d)
    if (nrow(test_df_day) == 0 || nrow(train_df_day) == 0) next

    mats <- make_feature_mats(train_df_day, test_df_day)
    if (is.null(mats)) next

    y_train <- train_df_day$win
    y_test  <- test_df_day$win
    if (length(unique(y_train)) < 2) next

    train_df_glm <- data.frame(win = y_train, mats$train, check.names = TRUE)
    fit <- try(glm(win ~ ., data = train_df_glm, family = binomial(), control = list(maxit = 200)), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) next

    test_df_glm <- data.frame(mats$test, check.names = TRUE)
    pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test_df_glm, type = "response"), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) next

    all_preds[[as.character(d)]] <- test_df_day %>%
      transmute(
        date = game_date,
        game_id, sid, opp_sid,
        win = y_test,
        pred = as.numeric(pred)
      )
  }
  bind_rows(all_preds)
}

preds_xgb <- roll_preds_xgb(model_df)
preds_logreg <- roll_preds_logreg(model_df)
cat("XGB rolling preds:", nrow(preds_xgb), "\n")
cat("LogReg rolling preds:", nrow(preds_logreg), "\n")
```

## Out-of-Time Calibration Split

```{r oot_split}
oot_cutoff <- as.Date("2025-12-28")
split_oot <- function(df, cutoff_date) {
  list(
    train = df %>% filter(date < cutoff_date),
    test = df %>% filter(date >= cutoff_date)
  )
}
```

## Calibration (Platt + Isotonic) on OOT Window

```{r calibration_helpers}
fit_platt <- function(df_train) {
  glm(win ~ pred, data = df_train, family = binomial())
}

apply_platt <- function(model, pred) {
  as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = data.frame(pred = pred), type = "response"))
}

fit_isotonic <- function(df_train) {
  ord <- order(df_train$pred)
  iso <- isoreg(df_train$pred[ord], df_train$win[ord])
  stats::approxfun(iso$x, iso$yf, rule = 2)
}

apply_isotonic <- function(iso_fn, pred) {
  as.numeric(iso_fn(pred))
}

calibration_report <- function(df, label, cutoff_date) {
  splits <- split_oot(df, cutoff_date)
  train_df <- splits$train
  test_df  <- splits$test

  platt_model <- fit_platt(train_df)
  iso_fn <- fit_isotonic(train_df)

  test_df <- test_df %>%
    mutate(
      pred_platt = apply_platt(platt_model, pred),
      pred_iso = apply_isotonic(iso_fn, pred)
    )

  metrics <- tibble(
    model = label,
    base_auc = auc_manual(test_df$win, test_df$pred),
    base_logloss = log_loss(test_df$win, test_df$pred),
    base_brier = brier(test_df$win, test_df$pred),
    base_ece = ece_score(test_df$win, test_df$pred),
    platt_auc = auc_manual(test_df$win, test_df$pred_platt),
    platt_logloss = log_loss(test_df$win, test_df$pred_platt),
    platt_brier = brier(test_df$win, test_df$pred_platt),
    platt_ece = ece_score(test_df$win, test_df$pred_platt),
    iso_auc = auc_manual(test_df$win, test_df$pred_iso),
    iso_logloss = log_loss(test_df$win, test_df$pred_iso),
    iso_brier = brier(test_df$win, test_df$pred_iso),
    iso_ece = ece_score(test_df$win, test_df$pred_iso),
    n_test = nrow(test_df)
  )

  list(metrics = metrics, test = test_df, platt_model = platt_model, iso_fn = iso_fn)
}
```

```{r calibration_run}
cal_xgb <- calibration_report(preds_xgb, "xgboost", oot_cutoff)
cal_logreg <- calibration_report(preds_logreg, "logreg", oot_cutoff)

metrics_all <- bind_rows(cal_xgb$metrics, cal_logreg$metrics)
metrics_all
```

## Reliability Plots (OOT Test)

```{r reliability_plots}
reliability_table <- function(df, prob_col, n_bins = 10) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      bin = cut(.data[[prob_col]], breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1), include.lowest = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarize(
      pred_mean = mean(.data[[prob_col]]),
      win_rate = mean(win),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  df
}

plot_reliability <- function(df, title) {
  plot(df$pred_mean, df$win_rate,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = "Predicted win prob", ylab = "Observed win rate",
       main = title, pch = 19)
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
}

par(mfrow = c(2, 3))

xgb_base <- reliability_table(cal_xgb$test, "pred")
xgb_platt <- reliability_table(cal_xgb$test, "pred_platt")
xgb_iso <- reliability_table(cal_xgb$test, "pred_iso")
plot_reliability(xgb_base, "XGB Base (OOT)")
plot_reliability(xgb_platt, "XGB Platt (OOT)")
plot_reliability(xgb_iso, "XGB Isotonic (OOT)")

log_base <- reliability_table(cal_logreg$test, "pred")
log_platt <- reliability_table(cal_logreg$test, "pred_platt")
log_iso <- reliability_table(cal_logreg$test, "pred_iso")
plot_reliability(log_base, "LogReg Base (OOT)")
plot_reliability(log_platt, "LogReg Platt (OOT)")
plot_reliability(log_iso, "LogReg Isotonic (OOT)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
